comments.author: @defiletia8838
comments.text:
I would like to help with the correct pronunciation of Hungarian city and town names.
Szeged - not Sheged, but only shortly Seged, not Debretshen, but Debretsen- without "h",  not Pecs, but Peitsh-with "h", and so on....

replies.author: @TravelBeyond4K
replies.text: Thanks for sharing this guide! Hungarian pronunciation can be tricky for outsiders, so this helpful list is really appreciated.

replies.author: @gaborszegedy1673
replies.text: @erzsebethyoung Sz sounds like Sh in Polish. Reason for confusion?

replies.author: @erzsebethyoung
replies.text:
In the Hungarian language S = Sh like sugar.

To make it sound like the English S you have to have Sz written with the S.
